title: Drift Wood #24 · gone
logline: The envelope is gone. The strip does not say where.

panels.composition: Wood's bedroom. The drawing table. The jar of pens. No envelope. WOOD drawing.

image.prompt: a teenage boy drawing at a bedroom table, a jar of pens on a clear tabletop where something used to be, black and white
image.notes: The absence is the panel. Compose so the empty spot beside the jar reads.

panels.composition: The wastebasket under the table. Crumpled drafts. Nothing else visible.

image.prompt: close-up of a wastebasket under a drawing table full of crumpled paper drafts

panels.composition: Wood pinning a new strip to the corkboard above the table. Among the pinned things: a Timberline back page, the crab flyer, the yearbook photo. No letter.

characters.pose: pinning a page to a corkboard

image.prompt: a teenage boy pinning a new comic strip to a crowded corkboard above his drawing table that holds a newspaper page, a crab flyer and a yearbook photo

panels.composition: Wide. The room. The window. Rain. Wood at the table. The corkboard. Whatever happened to the envelope happened off the page.

characters.pose: at the table, back to us

image.prompt: a wide quiet view of a teenage boy's bedroom at night from the door, the boy at his drawing table with his back turned, a crowded corkboard, rain in the window, no words

notes: Opened, answered, thrown away, or kept — the strip doesn't say. The afterword can.
